result.rationale: The diff shows `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` with no try/catch or safeParse in the handler. In a standard Next.js API route, a thrown ZodError results in an unhandled 500 HTML response rather than a 400 JSON error, while the rest of the handler carefully returns JSON error responses (403, 404). The mechanism is correctly described and verifiable from the diff (no surrounding error middleware is shown); it is a real defect in the new endpoint's error handling, though the exact runtime behavior depends on unseen middleware.
